svg.text: Implemented serving path
Streamlit question
Exact NCT or discovery
Exact NCT plus supported factual intent
Keep requested trial; bypass semantic ranking
Pinned MiniLM cosine over 2,824 trials
Preserve ranks and scores; bounded candidate scan
Record skips when required evidence is missing
Fixed read only Neo4j retrieval
Trial bound evidence plus source record IDs
Identity, coverage, pagination and citation checks
Verified answer or abstention
Deterministic facts and COMPLETE outcome listing
Citations, provenance, limitations and trace
Optional constrained Ollama after prepared evidence
One attempt; 60 second request bound; strict catalog ID validation
Separate offline research lane not the deployed ranker
Frozen V2 masks and partitions → MiniLM features → trained GraphSAGE plus query projection
Training only optimization → validation checkpoint selection → one frozen test comparison
61,218 permitted computational edges; held out trial context visible; not unseen trial induction
Original provenance remains in Neo4j. Similarity and graph messages are not clinical effectiveness evidence.
